11-02.a: رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِکَ وَلاَ تُخْزِنَا یَوْمَ الْقِیَامَهِ إِنَّکَ لاَ تُخْلِفُ الْمِیعَادَ
11-02.t: Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise.

11-03.a: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنکَ رَحْمَهً وَهَیِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
11-03.t: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

11-04.a: إِنَّ صَلاَتِی وَنُسُکِی وَمَحْیَایَ وَمَمَاتِی لِلّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِینَ
11-04.t: Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah , Lord of the worlds.

11-05.a: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا کَانَ غَرَامًا
11-05.t: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering

11-06.a: رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِکَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّیَاطِینِ
11-06.t: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,

11-07.a: رَبِّ إِنِّی أَعُوذُ بِکَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَکَ مَا لَیْسَ لِی بِهِ عِلْمٌ
11-07.t: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers.

11-08.a: رَبَّنا إِنَّکَ جامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لا رَيْبَ فيهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يُخْلِفُ الْميعادَ
11-08.t: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise.

11-09.a: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَیْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِینَ
11-09.t: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You].

11-10.t: And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants.

11-11.a: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ کُلَّ شَیْءٍ رَّحْمَهً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِینَ تَابُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِیلَکَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِیمِ
11-11.t: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those around it exalt [ Allah ] with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, [saying], "Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.

11-12.a: الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلاَ تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ
11-12.t: The truth is from your Lord, so never be among the doubters.

11-13.a: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِینَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِیمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِی قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِینَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّکَ رَؤُوفٌ رَّحِیمٌ
11-13.t: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.

11-14.a: وَ ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلاً لِلَّذينَ آمَنُوا امْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قالَتْ رَبِّ ابْنِ لي عِنْدَکَ بَيْتاً فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَ نَجِّني مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ عَمَلِهِ وَ نَجِّني مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمينَ
11-14.t: And Allah presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people.

11-15.a: يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنُوا تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحاً عَسى رَبُّکُمْ أَنْ يُکَفِّرَ عَنْکُمْ سَيِّئاتِکُمْ وَ يُدْخِلَکُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْري مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهارُ
11-15.t: O you who have believed, repent to Allah with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.

11-16.t: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

11-17.a: ما يُجادِلُ في آياتِ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ الَّذينَ کَفَرُوا فَلا يَغْرُرْکَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِي الْبِلادِ
11-17.t: No one disputes concerning the signs of Allah except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their [uninhibited] movement throughout the land.

11-18.a: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَیْرُ الرَّاحِمِینَ
11-18.t: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.

11-19.a: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَیْرُ الرَّاحِمِینَ
11-19.t: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.

11-20.a: وَ قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُريکُمْ آياتِهِ فَتَعْرِفُونَها وَ ما رَبُّکَ بِغافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
11-20.t: And say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allah . He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."

11-21.a: رَبِّ إِنِّی لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَیَّ مِنْ خَیْرٍ فَقِیرٌ
11-21.t: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.

11-22.a: وَاکْتُبْ لَنَا فِی هَذِهِ الدُّنْیَا حَسَنَهً وَفِی الآخِرَهِ
11-22.t: And decree for us in this world [that which is] good and [also] in the Hereafter; indeed, we have turned back to You." [ Allah ] said, "My punishment - I afflict with it whom I will, but My mercy encompasses all things." So I will decree it [especially] for those who fear Me and give zakah and those who believe in Our verses -

11-23.a: اِنَّهُ لَقُرآنٌ کَريمٌ * فی کِتابٍ مَکنُونٍ *لا يَمَسُّهُ اِلّا المُطَهَّرُون *
11-23.t: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an In a Register well-protected; None touch it except the purified.

11-24.a: انا نحن نزلنا الذکر و انا له لحافظون
11-24.t: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian.

11-25.a: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْکُمْ وَ اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّکُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
11-25.t: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allah that you may receive mercy.

11-26.a: إِنَّما وَلِيُّکُمُ اللَّهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ وَ الَّذينَ آمَنُوا الَّذينَ يُقيمُونَ الصَّلاةَ وَ يُؤْتُونَ الزَّکاةَ وَ هُمْ راکِعُونَ
11-26.t: Your ally is none but Allah and [therefore] His Messenger and those who have believed - those who establish prayer and give zakah, and they bow [in worship].

11-27.a: مَنْ کانَ عَدُوًّا لِلَّهِ وَ مَلائِکَتِهِ وَ رُسُلِهِ وَ جِبْريلَ وَ ميکالَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَدُوٌّ لِلْکافِرينَ
11-27.t: Whoever is an enemy to Allah and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael - then indeed, Allah is an enemy to the disbelievers.

11-28.t: O you who have believed, be persistently standing firm for Allah , witnesses in justice, and do not let the hatred of a people prevent you from being just. Be just; that is nearer to righteousness. And fear Allah ; indeed, Allah is Acquainted with what you do.

11-29.t: And do not approach the property of an orphan, except in the way that is best, until he reaches maturity. And fulfill [every] commitment. Indeed, the commitment is ever [that about which one will be] questioned.

11-30.t: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allah . Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.

about.a: قُلْ يا عِبادِيَ الَّذينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلى أَنْفُسِهِمْ لا تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَميعاً إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحيمُ
about.t: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah . Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
